resources.string: SIM, registration, signal, IMS, data, calls and SMS

A RIL is running but android.hardware.telephony is missing: the device tree does not copy the telephony feature XML (e.g. android.hardware.telephony.gsm.xml) to /vendor/etc/permissions, so the framework ignores the modem.
Neither the telephony feature nor a RIL was found: fine for a Wi-Fi-only device.
getActiveModemCount() is 0: the radio HAL is not registered or the multi-SIM config (persist.radio.multisim.config) disables every slot.
The ROM disables the radio on purpose (ro.radio.noril).
init is restarting the service in a loop: it crashes at start. Look at logcat -b radio and the tombstones (missing vendor library, SELinux denial, wrong modem firmware).
No rild instance is running: the radio HAL is unavailable. Check the init .rc of the vendor RIL and its libraries.
On Qualcomm devices netmgrd configures the rmnet interfaces: without it data calls come up in the modem but no traffic flows.
gsm.version.ril-impl or gsm.version.baseband is empty: rild did not load the vendor RIL or never reached the modem (QMI/SMD transport down, modem firmware not booted).
ro.baseband is \"apq\": the SoC is configured without a modem.
init.svc.* states are not readable here (SELinux); service checks skipped.
The card answers with an error (CARD_IO_ERROR/RESTRICTED): bad contact, wrong SIM voltage class or a UIM driver problem in the modem.
SIM ready but no active subscription (%1$s)
The card is READY but SubscriptionManager lists nothing: the SIM records (ICCID, IMSI) were not loaded, usually a qcril UIM problem or a crash of com.android.phone.
Enter the PIN (or PUK / network unlock code) and run again.
Every slot is ABSENT. If a SIM is inserted, the card status from the modem (QMI UIM) does not reach Android: check qcril and the SIM slot mapping.
The SIM never reached READY: right after boot this is normal for a few seconds; if it persists the UIM application is not activated (qcril UIM, modem not online).
Registered for data only (no CS domain): calls need IMS/VoLTE.
The PS domain is not registered (reject cause %1$s): no mobile data. Check the attach APN and the modem data profile.
%1$s is %2$s although its SIM is ready.
Turn airplane mode off and run the checks again.
The phone process gave no service state within 4 s: com.android.phone may be crashing or the radio HAL is not connected.
A cell is in range but registration was rejected (cause %1$s): SIM not provisioned, PLMN not allowed or IMEI rejected.
The radio is off although airplane mode is off: RADIO_POWER failed or the modem never came online (PIL boot, firmware, QMI transport). Look at logcat -b radio for RADIO_POWER.
Without a READY SIM there is no registration; fix the SIM check first.
The network rejected the registration (cause %1$s). Wrong IMEI, SIM not provisioned or a PLMN restriction.
The modem is searching but camps on no cell: band configuration (RFC/NV items), antenna switch, or modem firmware not matching the device.
The modem does not even search: radio not brought online (QMI NAS not answering, transport between RIL and modem down) or a wrong preferred network type.
Mobile data is turned off by the user.
Not registered on the PS domain, so no data connection is possible.
Wi-Fi is the default network and \"mobile data always active\" is off: the cellular link is idle by design.
Registered with data enabled but no data connection: data call setup fails (APN, qcril data service, netmgrd, rmnet driver). See the data probe.
Registered on a cell but SignalStrength is empty: the RIL does not answer SIGNAL_STRENGTH (signal bars stay empty).
Nothing to measure while not registered.
Values outside the physical range: %1$s. The RIL probably reports raw or positive values (unit conversion in the RIL or a shim).
LTE RSSI (%1$s dBm) is below RSRP (%2$s dBm), which is physically impossible: the RIL mixes up fields or units.
Level 0 despite a usable signal: the thresholds in carrier config or the RIL values are wrong.
RIL does not report cell info
No cells reported while not registered.
No cell is marked as serving although the phone is in service: the RIL does not fill the registered flag.

VoLTE is enabled for this carrier but IMS did not register: check the IMS service (phh IMS selected and running), the \"ims\" APN, the modem IMS profile (IPv4v6) and \"4G calling\" in the SIM settings.
phh IMS is installed but the framework binds %1$s (config_ims_mmtel_package): select phh IMS as the IMS service.
Carrier config does not enable VoLTE for this SIM, so IMS is not expected to register.
VoLTE disabled in the device overlay
config_device_volte_available is false: telephony never tries IMS. Set it in the device framework overlay (or persist.dbg.volte_avail_ovr=1 for a test).
Android hides the IMS state from normal apps. Grant DUMP from a PC (see Settings) to read it from dumpsys.
dumpsys did not show an IMS registration line on this build.
Mobile data works on %1$s: HTTP in %2$s ms (setup %3$s ms)
Not run: airplane mode is on
Could not request a cellular network
Turn mobile data on to test it. Wi-Fi may stay on: the probe uses the cellular network directly.
Not registered on the PS domain: fix registration first.
Registered but the data call never came up: APN settings, qcril data (QMI WDS), netmgrd or the rmnet/IPA driver. Look at logcat -b radio for SETUP_DATA_CALL.
The probe server answered with an unexpected code: a captive portal or a proxy of the carrier.
Network up on %1$s but no traffic
The data call is up but DNS or HTTP fails: routing or firewall rules (netd/BPF), rmnet MTU, IPv6-only APN without 464xlat, or the probe URL is unreachable.
Updates as the RIL reports changes
This device does not declare telephony.
Grant the Phone permission above to see live registration, signal and the call test.
No active subscription: showing the default phone.
Waiting for the first service state…
RSRP and RSSI over the last 3 minutes
VoLTE state and a data test through the cellular network
The hidden TelephonyManager IMS methods are blocked by the hidden-API policy on this build; run the automatic checks with DUMP granted instead.
Brings up mobile data even with Wi-Fi on and sends one HTTP request through it.
The dialer places the call; this screen watches the call state
LTE/NR voice during the call: IMS (VoLTE/VoNR)
For the incoming call, ask someone to call this phone: the app marks it as soon as it rings.
Incoming call rang (seen by the app)
Can both sides hear each other (earpiece and microphone)?
No CS registration and data on LTE/NR: the call can only be over IMS.
The carrier supports VoLTE but the call fell back to 2G/3G: IMS was not registered when the call started.
The RIL reported no voice or data RAT during the call.
Sends one SMS to this phone and waits for it to come back
Type the number of this SIM. Carrier rates may apply; the message also appears in the SMS app.
optional, not every carrier sends it
Sent, but not received within %1$s s
The network accepted the SMS but it never reached Android: incoming SMS path (qcril not delivering NEW_SMS, SMS over IMS without an IMS service), a wrong number, or the default SMS app swallowing it.
Not even the sent report arrived: the RIL never answered SEND_SMS (qcril SMS service, modem transport).
Radio off or RIL not available.
No network service: fix registration first.
No valid SMSC address: the SIM has no service centre number or the RIL cannot read it.
The RIL does not implement SMS sending on this path (e.g. SMS over IMS without an IMS service).
The network rejected the message (errorCode is the RP cause): SMSC, subscription or IMS SMS settings.
Blocked by Android (FDN, short code policy or rate limit).
The RIL or the modem reported an error; see logcat -b radio for SEND_SMS.
